calibration.title: Sorter setup
calibration.subtitle: Tune servos and the feeder
calibration.entrySubtitle: Servo positions, timings and the feeder
calibration.notConnectedDescription: Calibration moves the servos live, so the sorter has to be connected.
calibration.noPositionSelected: Select a position above to edit it
calibration.rawPulseTooltip: Raw servo pulse position (120-490), the exact value sent to the device.
calibration.testServoGate: Test: briefly opens the gate, then returns it to closed, so you can watch it move.
calibration.testServoPusher: Test: briefly fires the pusher left, then right, then returns it to neutral, so you can watch it move both ways.
calibration.pusherOffsetWarning: More than {{percent}}% away from neutral. The arm shouldn't touch the inner wall, and the further out you push it, the higher the risk of skipping gears or the horn shifting on the shaft.

paddleOpenDelay.label: Paddle Open Delay (ms)
paddleOpenDelay.description: How long the paddle gets to lower before the pusher fires. Longer if the pusher hits the card before the paddle is fully down; shorter to sort faster.

pusherHoldDuration.label: Pusher Hold Time (ms)
pusherHoldDuration.description: How long the pusher stays extended before returning to neutral. Longer if cards aren't pushed fully out before it retracts; keep it short, since holding against the end stop strains the servo horn.

paddleCloseDelay.label: Paddle Close Delay (ms)
paddleCloseDelay.description: How long after the pusher fires before this module's paddle closes again, independent of the pusher's own return timing. Longer if cards aren't fully clear before the gate shuts.

calibration.pushTestTooltip: Runs this module's push exactly as a route would, using the hold time and paddle close delay above (even before you save them). No card is fed; drop one onto the module first to see it pushed out.

feeder.heading: Feeder
feeder.speedTooltip: How fast and which way the feeder motor spins. 0% is stopped; drag either way to speed up in that direction.
feeder.feedRetryCountDescription: When a feed times out without delivering a card, send the feed command again up to this many times before pausing. 0 turns retries off.
feeder.settleDurationDescription: Extra time to keep feeding once the module 1 sensor sees the last card in the hopper, so it travels all the way into the mechanism before the motor stops.
feeder.reverseDurationDescription: Once a card reaches module 1, spin the roller backward this long so the next card in the hopper is pulled back instead of creeping forward into a double feed. 0 turns it off.

feederTest.heading: Feeder test
feederTest.description: Feed cards straight to the bottom bin without scanning, using the saved feeder settings.

scanRegion.heading: Scan region
scanRegion.instructions: Drag the box to move it and use the sliders to resize it. Line it up with a card sitting at module 1.
scanRegion.liveDetectionHint: The box is the fallback crop used when live detection can't find the card. The blue outline is a live preview of what detection sees.
scanRegion.captureSettleDescription: How long to wait after the feeder confirms a card has arrived before capturing a frame, so the card is fully still and in focus.
scanRegion.matchesNeededDescription: How many consecutive frames must agree on the same card before a scan is accepted. 1 is fastest; higher values are more reliable but slower.
scanRegion.checkBothOrientationsDescription: Also match the card rotated 180°, so cards fed upside down are still identified. Turn off if all your cards are fed the same way up to make each scan faster.

connection.title: Connection
connection.autoConnectDescription: Connects to this sorter on its own when the app opens, and keeps trying to reconnect if it drops or is power-cycled while the app is open. Connect it by hand once first so the phone remembers it.
connection.testOnConnectDescription: When on, the sorter cycles every servo and checks its sensors each time it connects. When off, it only loads its saved calibration and is ready right away. You can still run the test from Sorter setup.
connection.pipelinedFeedLabel: Scan the next card while sorting
connection.pipelinedFeedDescription: Feeds and scans the next card as soon as the previous one has left module 1, instead of waiting for it to reach its bin. Needs firmware 2.1.0 or newer and auto-feed turned on. Turn this off if cards jam or scans start picking up the moving card.

leaderboard.description: Show your organization's name and how many cards it has scanned on the leaderboard in Stats. Every organization can see the leaderboard.
leaderboard.toggleLabel: Show my organization on the leaderboard

sessionWrapped.heading: Session Wrapped
sessionWrapped.description: Show a Wrapped-style recap of stat highlights before the export summary.

ocr.heading: Text recognition (OCR)
ocr.description: When a scan isn't a confident match, read the card's name and set line to find it. Applies to every scanner in this organization, for games with text regions set up.
ocr.highAccuracyDescription: Read the text on every card, not only uncertain ones, so the set and number can correct a confident but wrong match. Scans take a little longer.

foilDetection.heading: Foil detection
foilDetection.description: Mark a scan as foil automatically. Only used for printings that come in both foil and non-foil, and only while the scanner's foil setting is off.
foilDetection.starToggleDescription: Mark Magic cards as foil when the collector line shows the ★ printed on foils. Works on every device and adds no time.

correctionAutoClose.heading: Card correction prompt
correctionAutoClose.promptToggleLabel: Ask me to move corrected cards
correctionAutoClose.promptToggleDescription: Turn this off if you leave corrected cards where they were sorted. The card keeps its current bin and no prompt is shown.
correctionAutoClose.description: After you correct or identify a card, a prompt shows which bin it's in and which bin it belongs in. Auto-close accepts that you moved the card once the time runs out, so you don't have to click.
correctionAutoClose.toggleLabel: Auto-close and mark the card as moved

deployPause.heading: Updates
deployPause.description: When Mault is being updated, any sorter that's scanning is paused and a prompt explains why, so no cards are lost if a save fails mid-update. You can resume straight away from the prompt.

pricing.heading: Pricing
pricing.description: Choose which marketplace prices your organization's cards, collection values and Discord posts use. Card Kingdom only prices Magic: The Gathering cards.

conditionPricing.heading: Condition pricing
conditionPricing.description: How much of the Near Mint price a card in each condition is worth. Card values, collection totals, stats and storage values all use these.
conditionPricing.baseNote: Near Mint is always the full market price. The defaults match what most big sellers use.

draft.saveFailed: Couldn't save your settings. Try again.

org.removeMemberDescription: Remove "{{name}}" from this organization? They will lose access immediately.

org.memberLimitReached_other: Your plan includes {{count}} members per organization. Upgrade your plan on the web to invite more.

seatLocked.description_other: This organization's plan allows {{count}} members. Ask the owner to upgrade the plan or remove members.

apiKeys.heading: API keys
apiKeys.description: Let your own systems, like an online shop, read this organization's cards and storage locations. Keys belong to the organization, not to you, so they keep working if you leave.
apiKeys.revokeConfirmDescription: Anything using it stops working right away. This can't be undone.
apiKeys.createDescription: Give the key a name so you can tell later what uses it.
apiKeys.writeDescription: Read-only keys can list cards, collections and storage locations. Keys with write access can also take cards out of their box, move them to another box and delete them.
apiKeys.revealDescription: This is the only time the full key is shown. Store it somewhere safe, like your shop's secret settings.
apiKeys.managersOnly: Only organization owners and admins can create or revoke API keys.
apiKeys.upgrade: API keys aren't included in your plan.

webhooks.heading: Webhooks
webhooks.description: Mault posts an event to your URL when cards are scanned or put away into a storage location. Each webhook has its own signing secret so you can check a request really came from Mault.
webhooks.dialogDescription: Mault sends a signed POST request with a JSON body to this URL. It must be a public https:// address.

card.scanned: A card was scanned and saved to a collection.

cards.stored: A bin was put away into a storage location. Includes each card's box and position.

sorter.alert: A sorter jammed, errored, restarted, lost its connection or is due for service.

webhooks.deleteConfirmDescription: Mault stops sending events to this URL right away. This can't be undone.
webhooks.secretDescription: Use it to verify the X-Mault-Signature header on every request. This is the only time it's shown.
webhooks.upgrade: Webhooks aren't included in your plan.
webhooks.managersOnly: Only owners and admins can manage webhooks.

discord.description: Post scans and alerts to your Discord server.

channelSettings.description: Where every scan and every error or alert gets posted. Only owners and admins can change these.

rules.description: Post a card to a channel when it matches a rule. Every matching rule posts, so one card can go to several channels, but each channel gets it once.

rules.noChannel: No channel. Edit the rule to pick one.

rules.limitReached_other: Your plan includes {{count}} Discord notification rules. Upgrade your plan for more.

testNoChannel.title: No error channel set

ocrRegions.heading: OCR regions
ocrRegions.description: Where text is read on each game's cards when OCR is on, shown over a sample card from the database. Solid boxes are read first; dashed fallbacks are only read when the first pass doesn't find the card. Printing marks are compared against each printing's catalog image to tell printings of the same card apart.

cardLookup.description: Check whether a card is in the card database. Search by name, set code or collector number (e.g. MH3 123).

gameCoverage.description: Which trading card games are supported and how many cards are in the database for each.

guide.title: How to check a match
guide.intro: Compare the scan photo with the card it was matched to. Look at the name, the set symbol, the collector number and the artwork.

items.correct: The photo shows the same card in the same printing: same name, set symbol, collector number and art. Small differences in colour or lighting are fine.
items.incorrect: The photo shows a different card, or the same card from another set or printing, such as a different set symbol, collector number, frame or art.
items.badScan: You can't tell which card it is because the photo is blurry, cut off, covered in glare, shows more than one card or shows no card at all.
items.skip: Not sure? Skip it and someone else will check it.

matchValidations.saveError: Couldn't save your answer. Try that scan again.

users.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, email or organization

plans.billingDisabled: Billing is turned off on this server, so every organization gets every feature with no limits. These settings take effect once billing is on.
plans.featuresDescription: Which plans can use each feature. Features are defined in code, so a new one shows up here once it's built.
plans.limitsDescription: How much of each thing an organization on each plan can have. Turn on Unlimited to remove a limit.

chaosSort.label: Chaos sort
chaosSort.description: Fill bins in order, ignoring rules. Turning it off only stops new presets from switching it on.

storage.label: Storage locations
storage.description: Create locations and record bins into them. Existing locations stay viewable either way.

apiAccess.label: API access
apiAccess.description: Create organization API keys and read cards and storage locations through the public API. Revoking existing keys always works.

businessTools.label: Buy and sell
businessTools.description: Intake lots with buylist offers, order import and fulfilment, cost and margin reports, and spot checks. Existing records stay viewable either way.

repacks.label: Repacks
repacks.description: Build repacks from bin slots. Turning it off only stops presets from switching it on. Presets already in repack mode keep working.

customSounds.label: Custom sounds
customSounds.description: Upload custom sound clips for sound rules. Turning it off only stops new uploads. Clips already uploaded keep playing.

fleetHealth.label: Fleet health
fleetHealth.description: The sorter health panel on the Sorters page: status, cards since service, alert history and service intervals. Jam and offline alerts are still recorded and sent either way.

longShareLinks.label: Longer monitor links
longShareLinks.description: Monitor links can last 1, 7 or 30 days. Without it they last 1 hour. Trade links always last 1 hour.

dailyScans.label: Daily scans
dailyScans.description: Cards scanned per organization per UTC day.

connectedSorters.label: Connected sorters
connectedSorters.description: Sorters connected at once. Every plan is also capped at the server's hard maximum.

soundRules.label: Sound rules

notificationRules.label: Notification rules
notificationRules.description: Discord notification rules across all games. Only checked when adding a rule.

organizations.label: Owned organizations
organizations.description: Organizations a user may own. Checked in the app against the plan of the organization the user has open when creating a new one.

membersPerOrg.label: Members per organization
membersPerOrg.description: Members per organization, counted owners first, then by join date. Members past the limit are locked out until the plan is upgraded or members are removed.

collections.label: Collections
collections.description: Collections per organization. Only checked when creating a collection.

legacy.description: Only Free and the original Business plan are on sale, at the legacy Business prices. New Business subscribers get the legacy Business tier.
legacy.confirmDescription: Enthusiast and the new Business plan go on sale right away, using the STRIPE_PRICE_ID_ENTHUSIAST and STRIPE_PRICE_ID_BUSINESS prices. Current Business subscribers keep their plan and start seeing it labelled as legacy.

tiered.description: Free, Enthusiast and Business are on sale. Existing subscribers to the original Business plan keep it as the legacy tier.

tiered.confirmDescription: Enthusiast and the new Business plan stop being sold, and Business checkout goes back to the legacy prices. People who already subscribed to a new plan keep it.

preview.heading: Preview a plan
